project_type: TypeScript/React SPA with Vercel serverless API functions
build_system: pnpm workspaces, Vite for client, tsc --build for lib packages
test_command: No test runner available in sandbox (pnpm not installed), typecheck is primary validation
verification_instructions: Run tsc --build for lib packages, tsc --noEmit for artifacts/electron, and tsc --project api/tsconfig.json --noEmit for API
setup_instructions: pnpm not available in sandbox. Use ./node_modules/.bin/tsc directly for type checking.
environment_constraints: pnpm binary not available in sandbox. Only tsc (via node_modules/.bin/tsc) is available. No npm/npx. Build validation is limited to typecheck.
contribution_requirements: Use pnpm, follow skill-driven workflows per AGENTS.md. For our purposes - ensure typecheck passes.
key_patterns: Barrel exports in utils/index.ts and services/*/index.ts. Lazy loading via React.lazy. Polling via custom PollingManager. State via localStorage + API sync (stateClient.ts). API functions use withWebHandler pattern. memo() used on MoviesView, PlacesList, PlacesGrid, MovieCard.
directory_structure: src/ (app, components, hooks, services, utils, theme, shared, pages), api/ (serverless functions with _lib/), lib/ (workspace packages: db, api-client-react, api-spec, api-zod), artifacts/ (electron, api-server, electron-mobile, mockup-sandbox)
